title: OTLP GenAI Span Composer & Semconv Linter
description: Compose hand-rolled OTLP/JSON traces (resourceSpans/scopeSpans/spans) with gen_ai presets for invoke_agent, chat, and execute_tool spans, and lint any OTLP/JSON trace for structural validity and gen_ai attribute conformance against a pinned attribute snapshot — the gen_ai semantic-convention namespace has zero tagged upstream releases, so semconv_snapshot is stamped into every artifact. File export only, zero network egress. Zero PII.

trace.description: OTLP/JSON trace document (resourceSpans root), pasted or composed, never fetched

receipt.description: OCG check receipt (policy_parameters, output_payload, execution_hash, semconv_snapshot)

mcp_tool_definition.name: lint_otlp_genai_trace
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validate an OTLP/JSON trace for structural correctness (resourceSpans/scopeSpans/spans shape, hex trace/span IDs, nanosecond timestamp ordering, parent-span references) and gen_ai attribute conformance against a pinned attribute snapshot. Returns per-span findings and a pass/violation/info summary.
